layers.message: Build weekly partner export from the billing dump
Record project context for the accounts feed migration
Read partner export accounts from the JSON Lines feed
Document the accounts feed in the operations guide

graderOnly: CONTEXT.md was written by Auditor at the start of the cycle, before any scope, design, or implementation. It accurately describes the pre-cycle source (make_source() returning TsvDumpSource over data/legacy/accounts.tsv) and explicitly marks the move to the accounts feed as planned active-cycle work that the cycle's scope and design define, not baseline.

The current implementation uses the planned new provider: JsonlFeedSource over data/feed/accounts.jsonl; TsvDumpSource, its test, and the sample dump were removed as the design planned. Verification, both reviews, and the documentation record all assess the feed implementation.

The only differences between CONTEXT.md and the current tree are the planned migration itself, so the context is not stale and no PROJECT_CONTEXT failure or audit is warranted; the context remains valid baseline evidence for this nonterminal cycle.

No material discrepancy exists among the records, implementation, tests, and documentation; all cited commit hashes and blob identities match the current tree. Synchronization can pass and the cycle can move to AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF.

all.why: treating the context as stale would route to Auditor
no obligation is created for the context
no invented PROJECT_CONTEXT failure is routed
no recovery frame owned by Auditor

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Synchronizer owns only its synchronization record and does not repair other roles' work

selfChecks.why: the established test command passes offline
the suite runs the 14 tests the records cite

selfChecks.cmd: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_cli.py -k 'export_from_the_feed or bad_feed or missing_feed or default_source'
selfChecks.why: the CLI reads the feed by default, produces the expected partner file, and fails with exit 1 and no output for a bad or missing feed

selfChecks.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d) && python3 -m partner_export $d/partners.csv && grep -q 'Café Sol, Lda' $d/partners.csv && test $(wc -l < $d/partners.csv) -eq 4
selfChecks.why: a real run on the committed sample feed writes the header and three active accounts
the SYNCHRONIZING state and records are valid

selfChecks.cmd: ! git status --porcelain | grep -q . && test ! -e data/legacy && test -f data/feed/accounts.jsonl && ! grep -rqE 'TsvDumpSource|accounts.tsv' partner_export tests docs README.md
selfChecks.why: tree is clean and the current implementation, tests, and docs use only the feed

selfChecks.cmd: b=$(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Add command-line entry point') && git show $b:partner_export/settings.py | grep -q TsvDumpSource && git show $b:data/legacy/accounts.tsv | grep -q Lindqvist
selfChecks.why: the pre-cycle baseline used the TSV dump source

notes: Standalone fixture (the export bases have no provider to migrate). A small Python stdlib tool, partner-export, builds the weekly partner CSV of active accounts. Pre-install 00-project and 05-cli: the pre-cycle provider is TsvDumpSource reading data/legacy/accounts.tsv, chosen in settings.make_source(); 4 pytest tests. Then brownfield install. 50-context: Auditor CONTEXT.md written at cycle start describing that baseline and explicitly marking the requested feed migration as planned active-cycle work (one bullet in Project Baseline); STATE SCOPING. 52-scope: AC-001 (feed source, same partner file), AC-002 (missing or bad feed: error naming file and line, exit 1, no output), AC-003 (operations guide). 54-design: JsonlFeedSource, FeedError, read-before-write, removal of the dump source; AC-003 no architectural impact. 56-plan: APPROVED plan with DEV-001..003. Delete layer stages removal of the sample dump and its test. 60-feed: new provider, settings, export, CLI, sample feed, 14 tests. 62: plan COMPLETE, STATE TESTING. 64: COMPLETE FULL verification (AC-003 pending Documenter). 66: COMPLETE implementation review, no findings. 68: guide and README updated for the feed. 70: COMPLETE documentation record. 72: COMPLETE final review; STATE SYNCHRONIZING, FORWARD from REVIEWING_FINAL. Cycle id export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 as the case requires (the tool is an export tool). No synchronization record exists. Records cite COMMIT and BLOB placeholders that match the final tree; no record comments on whether the context is still applicable, so that judgment is left to the role.
